records.original_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT value,
         SUM(value) OVER (PARTITION BY value % 5) AS win_sum,
         (SELECT SUM(b.value) FROM example.data.numbers b WHERE b.value % 5 = a.value % 5) AS sub_sum
  FROM example.data.numbers a
)
WHERE win_sum IS DISTINCT FROM sub_sum;
records.replacement_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
  SELECT a.value,
         SUM(a.value) OVER (PARTITION BY a.value % 5) AS win_sum,
         totals.sub_sum
  FROM example.data.numbers a
  JOIN (
    SELECT value % 5 AS bucket, SUM(value) AS sub_sum
    FROM example.data.numbers
    GROUP BY value % 5
  ) totals ON totals.bucket = a.value % 5
)
WHERE win_sum IS DISTINCT FROM sub_sum;
records.reason: DataFusion 55 does not execute this correlated scalar subquery shape; joining the independently grouped totals preserves the same per-row correctness assertion using its existing join and window APIs.

records.original_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM duckdb_functions() WHERE function_name = 'vgi_table_scan';
records.replacement_sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_catalog = 'example' AND table_schema = 'data' AND table_name = 'numbers';
records.reason: DuckDB resolves catalog scans through a synthetic vgi_table_scan function, while DataFusion resolves the equivalent provider through its catalog; information_schema.tables verifies that the attached scan remains resolvable after window planning.
